# rms_device (Resource)

Manages a Teltonika RMS Device. Supports RUT, TRB, and other device series.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rms_company" "main" {
  company_name = "My Company"
}

resource "rms_device" "router" {
  name               = "Office Router"
  device_series      = "rut"
  serial             = "0123456789"
  mac                = "00:11:22:33:44:55"
  company_id         = rms_company.main.id
  auto_credit_enable = true
  password           = "device-password"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_series` (String) The device series: rut, trb, etc.
- `name` (String) The name of the device.
- `serial` (String) The device serial number.

### Optional

- `auto_credit_enable` (Boolean) Whether to automatically enable credits for the device.
- `company_id` (Number) The company ID to assign the device to.
- `imei` (String) The IMEI (required for TRB devices).
- `mac` (String) The MAC address (required for RUT devices).
- `monitoring_enable` (Boolean) Whether monitoring is enabled for the device.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) The device password for initial validation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the device was added.
- `firmware` (String) The device firmware version.
- `id` (Number) The unique identifier for the device.
- `status` (String) The device status: online, offline, not_activated.
